items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-01-16
items.q: And Kid Punch took the job.

ctx.x: Would it be 1900 or would it be 1910 or 1920 or what?

No, I don't think it was that far back. That's it. Dewey used to wait on Basin Street, Emmanuel Perez. That's when I was very small. Yeah, that must bring back. Let's see, wait, I got to get that thing straight. I think Tom could tell you better than I could about that. Tom Alba? Yeah. Because I had learned how to play cornet, you know, and Tom was playing the violin. And Eddie Vincent was practicing every day with us. And then all at once he picked up and he left there with Jimmy Fallon and then we went north.…

items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: I come back and sat down, you know, before I could get a chance to play again, here come Punch you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember. I wasn't here, I heard about it.

So the boys come in and sat in one night with me, you know. Get up, love, let me play you something. Get my lip waked up, yeah. I got up, you know. But first somebody, Louis the man, came in first, you know. He'd come in and say, want to rest you up? I said, yeah. That's one of them jitney dancers. He sat on there and played about an hour. I went off and got caught and come back and everything. And Hudson's sitting right there looking at them, you know, differencing the musicians. I come back and sat down, you…
